summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals, including fine-grained read restrictions and the addition of new data types to the Iceberg type system. Community participation is encouraged in ongoing syncs, particularly regarding the integration with Spark and the evolution of the REST catalog specification.
highlights: Add finer grained read restrictions as part of loadTable
Add a file data type to Iceberg
Deprecate Equality Deletes in Iceberg V4
